Nathan's parable of the poor man's ewe lamb that 'drank from his cup' (2 Sam 12:3) sits at the hinge between literal and figurative. Yet the psalmist can also call YHWH 'my cup' in a positive sense: 'the LORD is the portion of my cup' (Ps 16:5) and 'my cup overflows' (Ps 23:5). Spanish 'copa,' French 'coupe,' and German 'Becher' all capture the vessel sense while the fate-metaphor transcends translation."
